title: Fractional CIO
headline: Fractional CIO
lede: Technology leadership that turns priorities into action.

children.text: Technology decisions affect nearly every part of the business — from security and operations to budgeting, growth, acquisitions, and AI adoption. But many small and midsized organizations do not need, or are not ready to hire, a full-time CIO.
Frontline provides experienced technology leadership that works alongside your executive team, internal IT staff, and existing technology providers.

leadStatement: We help establish direction, build practical technology roadmaps, manage priorities, develop policy, evaluate risk, control costs, and keep technology decisions aligned with where the business is actually going. And when the roadmap calls for technical work, Frontline has the engineering capability to help execute it.
problems: What should we spend — and why?

capabilitySections.label: More than IT advice
capabilitySections.title: Structure, direction, and accountability.
capabilitySections.aside: A Fractional CIO relationship should create structure, direction, and accountability — not another report that sits on a shelf.
items: Develop short- and long-term technology roadmaps
Establish technology budgets and investment priorities
Evaluate cybersecurity, operational, and business risk
Plan cloud, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and modernization initiatives
Evaluate AI opportunities and governance requirements
Manage technology vendors, contracts, renewals, and licensing
Improve onboarding, offboarding, and access-management processes
Establish documentation standards and operational procedures
Guide internal IT teams and outside technology providers
Prepare for growth, acquisitions, transitions, or regulatory requirements

process.title: Understand
process.description: Environment, risks, vendors, costs, documentation, and the business direction behind them.

process.title: Prioritize
process.description: Rank the work by business impact, risk, and dependency.

process.title: Plan & budget
process.description: Short- and long-term roadmaps with investment priorities leadership can approve.

process.title: Lead & review
process.description: Ongoing oversight, executive reviews, vendor management, and course correction.

engagementModels.title: Ongoing Fractional CIO
engagementModels.description: Recurring technology leadership, planning, executive reviews, budgeting, vendor management, risk oversight, and roadmap management.

engagementModels.title: Strategic Advisory
engagementModels.description: Focused executive guidance around technology planning, cybersecurity, AI, governance, acquisitions, transitions, or major initiatives.

engagementModels.title: Project & Remediation Leadership
engagementModels.description: Technology leadership for complex projects, modernization initiatives, migrations, business transitions, and remediation programs.

engagementModels.title: Fractional CIO + Managed Technology Services
engagementModels.description: Executive technology leadership backed by the engineering and operational resources required to execute and support the plan.

finalCtaTitle:
Tell us where the business is going.
We'll help build the technology plan to get there.
metaDescription: Experienced technology leadership for organizations that need direction, structure, accountability, and long-term planning without adding a full-time CIO.

title: Governance, Risk & Compliance
headline: Governance, Risk & Compliance
lede: Build compliance into the way your organization operates.

children.text: Cybersecurity and compliance cannot be solved by completing a questionnaire once a year.

Organizations increasingly face requirements from regulators, customers, insurance carriers, business partners, and government contracts. Meeting those requirements takes more than technology. It requires documented controls, policies, evidence, accountability, risk management, and ongoing remediation.

leadStatement: Frontline helps organizations build practical Governance, Risk & Compliance programs designed to move from assessment to readiness — and stay there.

capabilitySections.label: Understand where you stand
capabilitySections.title: A program begins with an accurate picture of the environment.
capabilitySections.aside: We translate those findings into a prioritized path forward — not simply a list of deficiencies.

capabilitySections.label: Build the documentation behind the program
capabilitySections.title: Controls have to be documented, implemented, and maintained.
capabilitySections.aside: Compliance requires more than having security controls in place. Organizations also need to demonstrate that their security and governance practices hold up over time.
capabilitySections.listIntro: Frontline can assist with the development and maintenance of:

capabilitySections.label: From finding the gap to fixing it
capabilitySections.title: We don't have to stop after telling you what is wrong.
capabilitySections.aside: When an assessment identifies technical deficiencies, Frontline can work with your organization to remediate them.

capabilitySections.label: An ongoing GRC operating model
capabilitySections.title: What an ongoing GRC relationship can include.
capabilitySections.aside: Instead of rebuilding the compliance program before every audit, customer review, or renewal, organizations can maintain their documentation, evidence, risks, controls, and remediation plans throughout the year.

processNote: The cycle repeats — readiness is maintained, not rebuilt.

engagementModels.title: Assessment & Readiness
engagementModels.description: Determine where you stand, identify gaps, and build a prioritized path forward.

engagementModels.title: GRC as a Service
engagementModels.description: Ongoing management of governance, risk, controls, evidence, policies, remediation, and readiness.

engagementModels.title: Compliance Remediation
engagementModels.description: Technical projects and engineering services designed to close identified security and compliance gaps.

engagementModels.title: GRC + Fractional CIO
engagementModels.description: Connect compliance requirements to technology planning, budgeting, executive leadership, risk decisions, and long-term strategy.

finalCtaTitle:
Compliance should be a managed process —
not an annual emergency.
metaDescription: Practical GRC programs built around ongoing risk management, documentation, policies, evidence, remediation, and audit readiness.

title: Cybersecurity
headline: Cybersecurity
lede: Practical cybersecurity for the environment you actually operate.

children.text: Cybersecurity is no longer an endpoint problem. Modern threats move through identities, email, cloud applications, endpoints, vendors, remote access, and human behavior. Protecting the business requires controls that work together across the entire technology environment.

Frontline combines cybersecurity strategy, modern security platforms, continuous monitoring, and hands-on technical expertise to help organizations reduce risk, strengthen resilience, and improve their ability to respond when something goes wrong.

leadStatement: The traditional office perimeter is gone. An attacker may never need to breach a firewall if they can compromise a user's identity instead.

capabilitySections.label: Protection across the modern technology stack
capabilitySections.title: Controls that work together.
capabilitySections.aside: Frontline builds security around the way modern organizations actually operate, combining endpoint, identity, cloud, access, monitoring, and recovery controls into a more complete security program.

process.title: Assess the posture
process.description: Understand the current security posture across the environment.

process.title: Identify the greatest risk
process.description: Surface the areas presenting the most meaningful risk.

process.title: Prioritize by business impact
process.description: Build a remediation plan based on impact, technical risk, and organizational priorities.

process.title: Remediate
process.description: Execute the technical work required to close the gap.

engagementModels.title: Cybersecurity Assessment
engagementModels.description: Understand the current security posture, identify meaningful risks, and establish priorities for improvement.

engagementModels.title: Security Remediation
engagementModels.description: Correct technical weaknesses identified through assessments, compliance initiatives, cyber-insurance requirements, or internal reviews.

engagementModels.title: Managed Cybersecurity
engagementModels.description: Ongoing protection, monitoring, security tooling, awareness, vulnerability management, and operational oversight.

engagementModels.title: Cybersecurity + GRC
engagementModels.description: Connect technical security controls directly to policies, evidence, risk management, compliance requirements, and ongoing governance.

finalCtaTitle:
Security should make the business more resilient —
not harder to operate.
finalCtaLede: Frontline helps organizations build cybersecurity programs that are practical, manageable, and aligned with the way the business actually operates.
metaDescription: Protect identities, endpoints, cloud applications, users, and business data through modern cybersecurity controls, monitoring, awareness, and hands-on remediation.

title: Managed Technology Services
headline: Managed Technology Services
lede: Technology services that carry strategy into execution.

children.text: A technology plan is only useful if someone can implement it, operate it, document it, and keep it working.
Frontline provides managed technology services backed by experienced engineers across cloud, cybersecurity, infrastructure, networking, systems, and modern IT operations.

leadStatement: We can operate as your primary technology provider, supplement an internal IT team, work alongside another service provider, or take responsibility for specific parts of the environment.

capabilitySections.label: More than a help desk
capabilitySections.title: Managed technology should do more than react to tickets.
capabilitySections.aside: Frontline helps organizations build technology environments that are standardized, documented, secure, supportable, and aligned with the direction of the business.

capabilitySections.label: Standardization
capabilitySections.title: Standardize before complexity becomes the standard.
capabilitySections.aside: Growing organizations often inherit years of one-off technology decisions. Different vendors. Different configurations. Undocumented systems. Aging equipment. Inconsistent security.

title: Private AI & AI Governance
headline: Private AI & AI Governance
lede: Put AI to work without giving up control of your data.

children.text: Employees are already using AI. The more important question is whether your organization knows which tools they are using, what information is being shared with them, and what controls are in place.
Frontline helps small and midsized organizations adopt AI deliberately — combining secure AI access, practical governance, data protection, user education, and private AI architecture.

leadStatement: The goal is not to stop AI adoption. It is to make AI useful without creating uncontrolled risk.
problems: Can employees upload customer documents to an AI tool?
Can employees use AI-generated content without review?
Which AI services and models are approved?

capabilitySections.label: AI for Business
capabilitySections.title: Give your team powerful AI tools inside a managed environment.
capabilitySections.aside: Instead of employees creating individual accounts across an expanding collection of public AI services, Frontline can help organizations establish centrally managed AI environments that provide access to leading commercial and open AI models.
capabilitySections.listIntro: Depending on the selected platform and architecture, capabilities can include:
items: Access to multiple leading AI models

capabilitySections.label: AI Governance
capabilitySections.title: Your AI policy should exist before an incident forces you to write one.
capabilitySections.aside: The goal is not to create a 70-page AI policy nobody reads. It is to establish rules employees can understand and controls the organization can actually enforce.
items: NIST AI Risk Management Framework alignment
Integration with broader cybersecurity and compliance programs

capabilitySections.label: Frontline Private AI
capabilitySections.title: When private needs to mean private.
capabilitySections.aside: Frontline is developing private AI architectures that bring AI inference, organizational knowledge, and internal workflows onto infrastructure controlled by the client. For supported workloads, a fully private environment can use locally hosted AI models without sending prompts or private organizational data to public AI APIs.

engagementModels.title: Governed Commercial AI
engagementModels.description: Access leading cloud AI models through an organizationally managed environment with centralized administration, defined policies, and stronger controls around business use.

engagementModels.title: Private Organizational AI
engagementModels.description: Connect managed AI services to approved company knowledge, applications, workflows, and governance while maintaining greater organizational control over how AI interacts with internal information.

engagementModels.title: Fully Private / Local AI
engagementModels.description: Deploy supported models and knowledge systems onto infrastructure controlled by the organization, reducing or eliminating dependency on public-model APIs for selected workloads.

engagementModels.title: AI Governance Program
engagementModels.description: Policies, risk assessment, training, application inventory, and NIST AI RMF alignment inside the broader cybersecurity and compliance program.

finalCtaTitle:
Use AI. Govern it.
Protect the data behind it.
finalCtaLede: Frontline can help determine where secure cloud AI makes sense, where stronger governance is needed, and where bringing selected AI workloads completely in-house may be the better approach.
metaDescription: Secure AI access, practical AI governance, private organizational knowledge, and private AI architecture designed around business requirements and data sensitivity.
